title: Mother and Four Daughters, House Porch Steps - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A deckled-edge black-and-white snapshot showing an American mother seated on the concrete steps of a wood clapboard house with her four daughters gathered closely around her. The children wear matching or coordinate patterned cotton daytime dresses with white collars, white ankle socks, and dark oxfords, with bobbed hairstyles characteristic of the late 1930s and early 1940s. Behind them sits a wooden screen door and a textured stone foundation, evoking everyday mid-century rural or small-town domestic life.
